rationale: Prajyot and Akshath both work on foundational robotics problems—Prajyot on sim-to-real learning pipelines and robot manipulation at Meta, and Akshath on SLAM and perception as a Senior Research Engineer at Collaborative Robotics. Their skill stacks overlap significantly (Python, C++, ROS), and Akshath's expertise in multi-camera SLAM and sensor placement directly complements Prajyot's work on mobile robotics and autonomous systems, creating potential for technical collaboration on perception-aware learning systems.
intro_message: Prajyot Patil, meet Akshath Singhal—you're both solving core robotics challenges (learning pipelines and SLAM) with overlapping tech stacks and complementary expertise in perception and autonomous systems.
